exposure: residence of mothers in the state capital
provision of guidance for mothers about the five tests in maternity hospitals
outcome: prevalence of newborn hearing screening test
proportion of newborns undergoing all five tests
cohort: The study included 415 mother and baby binomials from public maternity hospitals in Natal, RN, Brazil.
finding: The study found that none of the five neonatal screening tests achieved full coverage, with varying prevalences and only 36.6% of newborns receiving all tests, and that test performance was associated with mothers' residence in the state capital and the provision of guidance in maternity hospitals, indicating regional inequities.
cross-section timing: The study was performed in 2019, with prevalence observations taken in the first week and at the end of 28 days after birth for each baby.
